note: What it takes to turn this template into somebody's project: which files a new project gets, and which text in them carries a name. THE source of truth for that - scripts/rename.mjs executes it here, abap2UI5/mcp-server's lib/scaffold.mjs executes it over a checkout, and abap2UI5/vscode-extension snapshots it. Three programs, one description. Add a file or a substitution HERE.

templateOwn.README.md: describes the template itself; a project writes its own
templateOwn.CONTRIBUTING.md: how to contribute to the template, not to a project made from it
templateOwn.LICENSE: the template's copyright line, not the project's
templateOwn.scripts/rename.mjs: has nothing left to rename once it has renamed - and it reads template.json, which a project does not get either. Invoked as `node scripts/rename.mjs`, not through package.json, because every script in the SHARED package.json has to resolve to a shared file
templateOwn.scripts/check-template.mjs: gates this description against this repository; a project has no template.json to gate. Runs from .github/workflows/template-self-check.yml, which stays here too
templateOwn.scripts/generate-agents.mjs: regenerates what this template mirrors of the framework guide - the guide as one file under the build-an-app skill, and its essentials in AGENTS.md; a project has the result, not the generator
templateOwn.scripts/app-guide-deviations.mjs: abap2UI5's `.github/shared/app-guide-deviations.mjs`, copied here for that generator - the guide's deviations and the layout of its essentials are the template's, not a project's
templateOwn..github/workflows/pin-freshness.yml: weekly maintenance of the TEMPLATE's own framework pin, reported as an issue on this repository; a project decides its own pin policy and gets check.yml, which runs check:pin on every pull request
templateOwn..github/workflows/bump-linter.yaml: weekly maintenance of the TEMPLATE's own linter pin, gated by this repository's checks and opened as a PR here; a project decides its own bump policy the same way it decides its pin policy
templateOwn..github/workflows/template-self-check.ym: the gates that are about THIS repository rather than about a project made from it - template.json's description, the AGENTS.md mirror, and the unit tests for scripts/. check.yml used to run the first two and a project inherited steps it could not execute
templateOwn..github/workflows/sync-mirrors.yml: daily maintenance of the TEMPLATE's mirrors (the guide file, its essentials in AGENTS.md and .claude/skills/, regenerated from abap2UI5, and scripts/addons.json, from the addon catalogue), opened as a PR here; a project has the mirrored files, not the generators that workflow runs
templateOwn.scripts/test: unit tests for the scripts above, which a project does not get
templateOwn.scripts/lib: the substitution code scripts/rename.mjs and the create-abap2ui5-app package (create/) share; a project has nothing left to substitute, and no rename.mjs to import it
templateOwn.scripts/sync-create.mjs: copies scripts/lib/substitute.mjs into create/substitute.mjs (the published package has to be self-contained) and gates the copy byte-equal with --check from template-self-check.yml; a project publishes no package
templateOwn.scripts/sync-addons.mjs: rewrites scripts/addons.json - the snapshot `npm run add-addon` reads - from the addon catalogue and each addon's branches and tags; a project has the snapshot (and takes a newer one by copying it from the template's `main`), not the program that needs the catalogue to write it
templateOwn.scripts/generate-skills.mjs: mirrors the framework's four agent skills into .claude/skills/ here in their split form (a short SKILL.md and its references), with declared deviations, and keeps this file's lists of them; a project has the files, not the generator
templateOwn.create: the `create-abap2ui5-app` npm package - `npm create abap2ui5-app` - which reads THIS template.json and writes a project; a project is what it produces, not what it contains. Published by .github/workflows/publish-create.yml
templateOwn..github/workflows/publish-create.yml: manual-dispatch publish of create/ to npm, with this repository's NPM_TOKEN; a project has no package to publish
templateOwn..github/workflows/sync-shared.yaml: monthly maintenance of the TEMPLATE's copies of abap2UI5's shared files (.github/scripts/rename.mjs), pulled by the manifest abap2UI5's shared-file-gate.mjs keeps for THIS repository and opened as a PR here; a project is not in that manifest and takes a newer copy from the template's `main`

class.why: The ABAP source writes the name lower case and the sidecar's CLSNAME upper case. Renaming half of it produces an object abapGit imports under one name and ABAP activates under another - which is the whole reason this is a script and not an instruction. The test include names the class too (the class under test, and the reference to its attributes), so it is listed here and renamed with the pair.

agentSetup.note: What `npm create abap2ui5-app@latest -- --agent-setup [dir]` adds to a project that did NOT start from this template - most abap2UI5 projects. A subset of files.shared: the agent setup (AGENTS.md, the skills with the guide, the MCP server, the permission allowlist), the two gates it tells the agent to run, and the CI job that runs them. Never files.named: an existing project has its own src/, .abapgit.xml and package. A file the project already has is skipped and named, never overwritten - except the two under `merge`, which only ever ADD what is missing. Three programs execute this key: the create package (`--agent-setup`), abap2UI5/mcp-server's `add_agent_setup` tool and the VS Code extension's "Add Agent Setup to Workspace" command (from its snapshot) - each with the same rules, so a change here changes all three. rename.mjs and scaffold_app write whole projects from files.shared and files.named and do not read it. scripts/check-template.mjs holds it to files.shared: every shared file is either here or in leftOut, with its reason.

files.AGENTS.md: what an agent reads first, and the reason for the whole setup: a page about the repository, then the essentials of the framework's app-building guide and where the whole guide is. Its first part describes a project made from this template, and the create package says so after writing it
files.docs/project.md: the long form of AGENTS.md's first part - the gates, the addons, testing an app - which AGENTS.md sends a reader to; like that part it describes a project made from this template
files.CLAUDE.md: points Claude Code at AGENTS.md; other agents read AGENTS.md directly
files..claude/settings.json: the permission allowlist, so an agent runs the gates (`npm run check`, `npm run fix`, ...) without a prompt for each
files..claude/skills/build-an-app/SKILL.md: the checklist for writing an app class, loaded on demand
files..claude/skills/build-an-app/references/b: the framework's app-building guide, whole - the ONE copy in a project. AGENTS.md carries its essentials and says which section to read when; the build-an-app skill points here
files..claude/skills/build-an-app/references/c: a section of the build-an-app skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/view-chain-layout/SKILL.m: the layout rules for a builder chain and the linter rule that checks them
files..claude/skills/abap-check/SKILL.md: the ABAP a green CI does not catch - abapGit round trip, activation, runtime: the short index, its long sections are the references next to it
files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/1-a: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/2-a: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time

files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/4-d: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/5-r: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/7-r: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/abap-check/references/why: a section of the abap-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/ui5-check/SKILL.md: the UI5 a green CI does not catch - names the oldest supported release does not have: the short index, its long sections are the references next to it
files..claude/skills/ui5-check/references/1-na: a section of the ui5-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/ui5-check/references/2-la: a section of the ui5-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..claude/skills/ui5-check/references/4-ru: a section of the ui5-check skill, read when the table in its SKILL.md says so - a skill is loaded whole, its references one at a time
files..mcp.json: registers the abap2UI5 MCP server for Claude Code - sample search, view validation, headless run
files.abaplint.jsonc: the first gate, with the framework pinned for dependency resolution; its source glob follows the project's STARTING_FOLDER (sourceFolder below)
files.abap2ui5lint.jsonc: the second gate - every view checked statically and rendered headless; its paths follow the project's STARTING_FOLDER
files.package.json: MERGED, never replaced (see merge): the gates as devDependencies and the `npm run check*` scripts AGENTS.md and the allowlist name. Written from the template's when the project has none
files..nvmrc: the Node line the gates need - package.json's engines say >=22, check.yml runs 22, the doctor reads this file
files..gitignore: MERGED, never replaced (see merge): node_modules/ and .playwright/, or the gates' install lands in the next commit
files..github/workflows/check.yml: runs the two gates and the ABAP Unit job on every pull request - what makes an agent's green local run mean what CI's means; the unit job's paths follow the project's STARTING_FOLDER
files.scripts/check-pin.mjs: check.yml's first step (`npm run check:pin`) runs it - this set is closed under what it invokes, like files.shared
files.scripts/doctor.mjs: `npm run doctor`, where AGENTS.md sends an agent when a gate fails with a symptom instead of a cause; it imports check-pin.mjs and add-addon.mjs
files.scripts/add-addon.mjs: `npm run add-addon -- <repo>`, which the guide promises: registers an addon of abap2UI5-addons, and what it depends on, in abaplint.jsonc's dependencies - without it a call to an addon class fails the first gate with "Class ... not found"
files.scripts/addons.json: the snapshot add-addon.mjs and the doctor read: every addon with what it depends on, its entry classes and what abaplint can clone it at

leftOut.package-lock.json: locks the TEMPLATE's package.json, which a merged one is not; `npm install` writes the right lockfile - commit it, check.yml runs `npm ci`
leftOut..gitattributes: normalises line endings for the whole repository; in an existing one that rewrites files its history holds in another form - a decision about the repository, not part of an agent setup
leftOut..github/dependabot.yml: the update policy for every npm package and action of the whole repository, which an existing project has already decided (its own file, Renovate, or none); check.yml's SHA pins work without it
leftOut..devcontainer/devcontainer.json: an editor environment, not agent or gate setup - and a project with a container has its own
leftOut..vscode/extensions.json: editor recommendations, not agent or gate setup - and a project with a .vscode/ has its own
leftOut..github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc: the 7.02 downport config of scripts/check-702.mjs, which a project runs by hand when it targets NetWeaver 7.02 - its files glob is src/, and an existing project decides its own release targets
leftOut.scripts/check-702.mjs: the 7.02 downport check, run by hand (`node scripts/check-702.mjs`) and copying src/ - no package.json script or workflow invokes it, so an existing project that wants it copies it with the config above
leftOut..github/scripts/rename.mjs: abap2UI5's namespace rename, run by hand (`node .github/scripts/rename.mjs --name <name> --out <dir>`) when the framework is installed renamed; it reads src/ and abaplint.jsonc's framework pin and package.json config.renameOwn, which the agent-setup merge does not carry

package.json.why: each entry under these keys is added when the project lacks it and left alone when it has it, whatever its value - a project's own `check` script or abaplint version is its decision, and the create package names every one it kept. A devDependency the project lists under dependencies counts as present

.gitignore.why: the template's patterns the project does not ignore yet are appended, each with the comment above it; nothing is reordered or removed

sourceFolder.why: the template keeps its classes in src/, and four of these files say so. An existing project's .abapgit.xml says where it keeps them (STARTING_FOLDER), and a gate pointed at a src/ that is not there checks nothing - and passes. Each edit replaces `placeholder` inside the FIRST occurrence of `text`: the first `"files"` in abaplint.jsonc is global.files, the second is the framework dependency's own folder and stays

existingVariants.why: abaplint also reads abaplint.json, and many abapGit projects have one. The template's abaplint.jsonc is still added - `npm run check:abap` and the pin check read that one - and the create package says the project now has both
